tagline.zh: 进度形态随「确定性」变:骨架块(什么都不知道)→ 循环扫光(知道在加载)→ 百分比条(知道还剩多少)→ 完成快速淡入;形态切换按 NN/g 时长阈值演进,越接近终点动力越强(目标梯度)。
tagline.en: Progress form follows certainty: skeleton blocks (nothing known) → looping sweep (loading, but not how long) → percent bar (exactly how much is left) → fast fade-in completion; the form switches at NN/g duration thresholds, and momentum builds toward the end (goal-gradient).

origin.zh: NN/g《Progress Indicators》的选型阈值:<1s 用即时状态变化、1s 以上必须给进度指示、循环动画适合 2–10s、10s 以上用 percent-done 进度条并附文字说明、>10s 还应给完成时间估计;有进度指示时用户平均可等待约 3 倍时长(内布拉斯加大学实验转述)(调研 04§2.2);骨架脉动/完成后快速淡入出自 M3 skeleton loaders(调研 04§2.2);目标梯度效应(越接近目标动力越强、人为进度)出自 Laws of UX(补研 12§14)。
origin.en: NN/g's "Progress Indicators" selection thresholds: instant state change under 1s, an indicator is mandatory past 1s, looped animation suits 2–10s, 10s+ wants a percent-done bar with descriptive text and — beyond 10s — an ETA; with an indicator users tolerate about 3× the wait (Nebraska study relayed by NN/g) (research 04 §2.2); the skeleton pulse and fast completion fade come from M3 skeleton loaders (research 04 §2.2); the goal-gradient effect (effort grows near the goal; artificial progress) from Laws of UX (12 §14).

effect.zh: 模拟任务总时长(JS 型,demo 以 rAF 时间轴驱动)。默认 10000ms 恰好落在 NN/g「10s 以上用 percent-done 进度条 + 文字说明」的阈值上,演示的 percent 段因此成立;≥4s 才能完整走完骨架→循环→百分比三段。
effect.en: Simulated task duration (JS-type, driven by the demo's rAF timeline). The default 10000ms sits exactly on NN/g's "10s+ wants a percent-done bar with descriptive text" threshold, which is what makes the percent phase legitimate; 4s+ is needed to walk skeleton→loop→percent in full.

effect.zh: 不确定段的循环周期(骨架脉动与扫光共用),CSS 型参数。M3 只要求「微妙脉动」,未记载数值——1200ms 为社区常见值,未证实(与 skeleton-loading 条目同一口径)。
effect.en: Loop period of the indeterminate phase (shared by the skeleton pulse and the sweep), a CSS-type param. M3 only requires a "subtle pulse" with no recorded number — 1200ms is a common community value, unverified (same convention as the skeleton-loading entry).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换时间轴):auto 按 NN/g 阈值自动演进(0–1s 骨架 → 1–3s 循环扫光 → 3s–total 百分比 → 完成);其余档强制固定在某一种形态供对照(percent 档跑完仍会完成)。形态切换本身即本条目的主题:不确定性下降时,进度形态跟着换。
effect.en: JS-type param (the demo subscribes and switches the timeline): auto evolves through NN/g thresholds (0–1s skeleton → 1–3s looped bar → 3s–total percent → done); the other tiers pin one form for comparison (the percent tier still completes). The form switching itself is the entry's theme: as uncertainty falls, the progress form follows.

note.zh: 纯 CSS 渐变/transform 动画 + rAF 时间轴 + data 属性切换,全浏览器可用,无新特性依赖;不支持时进度退化为文本状态(「正在加载…」),语义不受影响。
note.en: Pure CSS gradient/transform animation, an rAF timeline and data-attribute switching — available everywhere with no modern-feature dependency; without it progress degrades to textual status ("Loading…"), semantics intact.

fallback.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时停用脉动/扫光(色块与轨道保持静态)与形态切换的过渡(直切),百分比数值仍按时间轴推进——数值更新是信息不是装饰;完成态不做淡入直接呈现。「正在加载」的语义不得只靠动画传达:aria-busy + 可见状态文字全程兜底;确定段用 role=progressbar + aria-valuenow 同步。
fallback.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the pulse/sweep is disabled (blocks and track stay static) and form switches jump instead of tweening, while the percent value still advances on the timeline — numeric updates are information, not decoration; the done state appears without fading. The loading semantics must never ride on motion alone: aria-busy + visible status text carry it throughout; the determinate phase syncs role=progressbar + aria-valuenow.

use.zh: 预期 ≥10s 的长任务(导出、上传、批量处理)——percent-done + 文字说明 + 完成时间估计(NN/g 阈值)
use.en: Long tasks expected at 10s+ (export, upload, batch processing) — percent-done + descriptive text + ETA (NN/g thresholds)

use.zh: 「先不确定、后确定」的真实任务:先骨架/循环,拿到可量化进度后切百分比条
use.en: Truly "uncertain first, certain later" tasks: skeleton/loop first, switch to the percent bar once quantifiable progress exists

use.zh: 多阶段流程的总进度(阶段本身是人为进度——预盖章式的起步进度,目标梯度效应,补研 12§14)
use.en: Multi-stage overall progress (the seeded stage is artificial progress — the goal-gradient effect, 12 §14)

avoid.zh: 预期 <1s 的请求——NN/g:用即时状态变化即可,进度指示反而制造等待感
avoid.en: Requests expected under 1s — NN/g: instant state change suffices; an indicator manufactures waiting

avoid.zh: 把循环动画挂在 >10s 的任务上——无终点的旋转让人「盯着钟看」,尽早升级为百分比
avoid.en: Looped animation on a 10s+ task — an endless spinner makes people watch the clock; upgrade to percent as early as possible

avoid.zh: 假装的百分比(均匀爬到 90% 卡住)——比循环动画更伤信任;没有真实进度就诚实用循环形态
avoid.en: Fake percentages (evenly creeping to 90% then stalling) — worse for trust than a loop; without real progress, honestly stay looped

a11y.zh: 加载语义全程经 aria-busy + 可见状态文字传达,不依赖任何动画;不确定段不提供 aria-valuenow(没有真实值,编一个就是撒谎);确定段用 role=progressbar(aria-valuemin/max/now 逐帧同步)并在文字里给出百分比与预计剩余;完成态 aria-busy 置 false 并播报;reduced-motion 下动画停、数值照走。
a11y.en: Loading semantics ride on aria-busy + visible status text throughout, never on motion alone; the indeterminate phase provides no aria-valuenow (no real value exists — inventing one is lying); the determinate phase uses role=progressbar (aria-valuemin/max/now synced per frame) with percentage and ETA in text; the done state flips aria-busy off and is announced; under reduced-motion the animation stops while values keep updating.

goal.zh: 复刻一张「不确定→确定」的进度卡:0–1s 骨架块脉动 → 1–3s 循环扫光条 → 3s 到 total 挂 role=progressbar 的百分比条(附百分比文字与预计剩余)→ 完成后内容 200ms 快速淡入;形态切换直切或微过渡,aria-busy 与状态文字全程同步。
goal.en: Replicate an uncertain→certain progress card: 0–1s pulsing skeleton blocks → 1–3s looping sweep bar → from 3s to total a percent bar with role=progressbar (percentage text and ETA) → content fades in fast at 200ms on completion; form switches cut directly or tween subtly, with aria-busy and status text synced throughout.

acceptance.zh: 形态按时长阈值演进:骨架(<1s 段)→ 循环(2–10s 区间语义)→ 百分比(≥10s 语义)+ 文字说明与完成时间估计
acceptance.en: Forms evolve by duration thresholds: skeleton (the <1s zone) → loop (the 2–10s semantics) → percent (the ≥10s semantics) + descriptive text and ETA

acceptance.zh: 脉动/扫光周期取参数快照 --prog-pulse,只动 transform(合成器路径)
acceptance.en: Pulse/sweep period follows the snapshot --prog-pulse, animating only transform (compositor path)

acceptance.zh: 确定段 role=progressbar 同步 aria-valuenow,不确定段不提供数值(不编造进度)
acceptance.en: The determinate phase syncs aria-valuenow on role=progressbar; the indeterminate phase provides no value (no invented progress)

acceptance.zh: 完成态内容以 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)(M3 short4 + Standard)快速淡入
acceptance.en: Done-state content fades in fast at 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) (M3 short4 + Standard)

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时停用脉动/扫光/淡入,数值与状态文字照常更新
acceptance.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, pulse/sweep/fade are disabled while values and status text keep updating
